text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear introductory thesis","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a recognizable introduction, body, and conclusion to guide the reader through its argument."},{"evidence":"\"Firstly,\" \"Secondly,\" \"Lastly,\"","quality":"structuring devices","description":"It uses transitional markers to sequence ideas and make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"multi-sentence paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops each point with supporting explanation rather than relying on isolated statements."},{"evidence":"\"science fair analogy\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"It uses an extended example to explain and reinforce its claims."},{"evidence":"\"however,\" \"additionally,\" \"therefore,\"","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"It connects sentences and ideas with varied logical connectors."},{"evidence":"mostly readable sentences","quality":"sentence control","description":"Its sentences are generally grammatical and complete enough to communicate ideas clearly."},{"evidence":"\"interests,\" \"creativity,\" \"knowledge\"","quality":"idea clarity","description":"The essay expresses its main points in a coherent, focused way that stays on the prompt."},{"evidence":"topic-specific vocabulary like \"incentive\" and \"specialize\"","quality":"academic language","description":"It uses more formal, school-appropriate word choice than the other essay."}]}
